item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya wants to find out whether warm or cold conditions change the speed at which water travels up a plant stem. She has two similar hibiscus twigs cut from the same plant, two identical glasses, and some red ink. Which plan is a fair test of her question?

options.A: Put both twigs in glasses with equal amounts of red ink water; keep one glass in a warm sunny window and the other in a cool fridge; record which twig shows red colour in its leaves first.
options.B: Put a long twig in red ink water in the warm window and a short twig in plain water in the fridge; record which twig shows red colour first.
options.C: Put one hibiscus twig in red ink water in the warm window and one rose twig in red ink water in the fridge; record which twig shows red colour first.
options.D: Put both twigs in the warm window, one in a glass with a little red ink and one in a glass full of red ink; record which twig shows red colour first.
